metadata.scope: Country-by-team English Wikipedia categories associated with European domestic, regional and continental basketball leagues.
metadata.ratingExplanation: Head-coach honors receive full competition-specific value. Assistant, consultant and youth honors receive reduced value. Player achievements remain in the database but receive zero coaching points. Experience is added and raw scores are percentile-ranked across the scraped European pool. The 99th percentile and above is capped at 90.

coaches.name: Žan Tabak
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Spain by team
Category:Basketball coaches in Poland by team

biography.introduction: Žan Tabak (born 15 June 1970) is a Croatian professional basketball coach and former player who is now serving as the head coach for BC Andorra of the Liga ACB. His basketball career, spanning twenty years, was marked by several notable achievements, despite injuries. He was the first international player to play in the NBA Finals for two teams. Žan Tabak averaged 5.0 points in his 6-year NBA career.

coaches.name: Mike Taylor (basketball coach)
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Germany by team

biography.introduction: Michael Richard Taylor (born August 29, 1972) is an American basketball coach. He most recently served as head coach and general manager of the Winnipeg Sea Bears of the Canadian Elite Basketball League (CEBL). Previously, he was head coach of the Poland national team, which he led to the round of 16 at the 2015 EuroBasket and the quarter-finals of the 2019 FIBA World Cup.

coaches.name: Chris Thomas (basketball coach)
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Croatia by team

biography.introduction: Chris Thomas (born 1980) is an American professional basketball coach. He served as the head coach at Cibona Zagreb in the ABA League. He has also been the coach of the Guaynabo Mets of the Liga de Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN). He was an assistant coach for several college basketball teams, most notably the Miami RedHawks, and the Slovenia national basketball team.

coaches.name: Valeri Tikhonenko
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Russia by team

biography.introduction: Valeri Tikhonenko (Russian: Валерий Алексеевич Тихоненко; born 19 August 1964) is a retired Soviet and Russian professional basketball player and coach. During his playing career, he played at the small forward and power forward positions, with power forward being his main position. He represented both the Soviet Union and Russia in national team competitions. With the Soviet Union, he won a gold medal at the 1988 Summer Olympics.

sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Kosovo by team

image.caption: Todorov with MZT Skopje Aerodrom in 2011

biography.introduction: Aleksandar Todorov (Macedonian: Александар Тодоров; born July 17, 1973) is a former Macedonian basketball coach, who works as a General manager since 2021. He was the head coach of MZT Skopje, when they won the title for the first time in their history, and won the first game ever for a Macedonian team in Adriatic League. In addition to his Macedonian citizenship, Todorov also holds Bulgarian citizenship.
